publisher: National Weather Service, Weather Forecast Office Hanford, California

publicProduct.publicationTimeMeaning: Last Update stated by the source web page, not inferred from download time
publicProduct.updatePolicy: Event-driven; page states normally updated by 6 a.m. when impactful weather is expected
publicProduct.collection: Existing GitHub Pages workflow, target 15 minutes; browser checks metadata each minute while visible. Scheduling is not guaranteed.

use: Context for reading forecast timing, impacts, uncertainty and geography. Briefing contents are not CAP alerts or configured county deployment thresholds.
retention: Public current PDF snapshot retains the last good collection with explicit errors and original times on failure. No automatic mailbox access.
owner: County GIS maintains the collector; County OES coordinates with NWS Hanford.
